# Now 2.13.94
- Amazon Music in Safari or Chrome is now supported: the overlay follows the track, progress and synced lyrics, with play, pause, next, previous and scrubbing, and cover art at full resolution. - Amazon do not ship an Apple Silicon build of their desktop app, so the web player is the way to use Amazon Music on a current Mac.

# Now 2.13.93
- Fixed the artwork getting stuck part-way off the overlay when swiping during a podcast. The swipe is now ignored outright for sources with no episode queue, instead of letting the cover move and then having nothing to complete the gesture. - If a swipe finds no cover to move to, the artwork now glides back into place rather than staying where it was left.

# Now 2.13.92
- Swiping the artwork no longer misbehaves on Apple Podcasts. Podcasts has no previous or next episode to move to, so the swipe was showing the cover of a show you listened to earlier while restarting the episode you were already on, and the mismatch never corrected itself. Swiping is now inactive for podcasts. - If a swipe does not actually change the track, the overlay now puts the real cover back instead of keeping the one it previewed. - Amazon Music is enabled by default for new installs.
